description: VC5 COFF byte target for the opening About dialog prelude: CAboutDlg constructor, the shared ret-4 address-group sentinel at 0x401020 represented by the inherited CWnd::DoDataExchange COFF symbol, message-map accessor, and adjacent MFC provider modal-state wrappers. Retail vtable and message-map xrefs place CWnd::DoDataExchange plus the HudUiTextInput and CZRecoilFrame no-op identities in this seven-xref physical group; CObject::Serialize and CObject::Dump instead belong to the separate 0x407150 ret-4 group. This raw target proves bytes, not linked representative placement or authored About ownership.
